   865→def _handle_find_missing_nodes(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   866→    path_str = tool_input.get("path")
   867→
   868→    # Get workflow
   869→    if path_str:
   870→        path = Path(path_str)
   871→        if not path.exists():
   872→            return to_json({"error": f"File not found: {path_str}"})
   873→        try:
   874→            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   875→        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
   876→            return to_json({"error": f"Invalid JSON: {e}"})
   877→
   878→        # Extract API-format nodes
   879→        if "nodes" in data and isinstance(data["nodes"], list):
   880→            prompt_data = data.get("extra", {}).get("prompt")
   881→            if prompt_data and isinstance(prompt_data, dict):
   882→                workflow = {
   883→                    k: v for k, v in prompt_data.items()
   884→                    if isinstance(v, dict) and "class_type" in v
   885→                }
   886→            else:
   887→                # UI-only: extract class_types from nodes array
   888→                workflow = {}
   889→                for node in data["nodes"]:
   890→                    nid = str(node.get("id", ""))
   891→                    ntype = node.get("type", "")
   892→                    if ntype:
   893→                        workflow[nid] = {"class_type": ntype, "inputs": {}}
   894→        else:
   895→            workflow = {
   896→                k: v for k, v in data.items()
   897→                if isinstance(v, dict) and "class_type" in v
   898→            }
   899→    else:
   900→        from .workflow_patch import get_current_workflow
   901→        workflow = get_current_workflow()
   902→        if workflow is None:
   903→            return to_json({
   904→                "error": (
   905→                    "No workflow loaded. Either provide a 'path' or load one "
   906→                    "with apply_workflow_patch first."
   907→                ),
   908→            })
   909→
   910→    # Collect unique class_types
   911→    class_types = set()
   912→    for node in workflow.values():
   913→        ct = node.get("class_type")
   914→        if ct:
   915→            class_types.add(ct)
   916→
   917→    if not class_types:
   918→        return to_json({"error": "No nodes found in workflow."})
   919→
   920→    # Check which are available in live ComfyUI
   921→    available = set()
   922→    try:
   923→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   924→            resp = client.get(f"{COMFYUI_URL}/object_info", timeout=15.0)
   925→            resp.raise_for_status()
   926→            object_info = resp.json()
   927→            available = set(object_info.keys())
   928→    except httpx.ConnectError:
   929→        return to_json({
   930→            "error": "ComfyUI not reachable. Start ComfyUI to check node availability.",
   931→        })
   932→    except Exception as e:
   933→        return to_json({"error": f"Could not fetch node info: {e}"})
   934→
   935→    # Classify
   936→    installed = sorted(class_types & available)
   937→    missing = sorted(class_types - available)
   938→
   939→    # Look up missing nodes in extension-node-map
   940→    index = _build_node_to_pack()
   941→    missing_report = []
   942→    packs_needed = {}  # url -> {title, nodes}
   943→
   944→    for node_type in missing:
   945→        pack_info = index.get(node_type)
   946→        if pack_info:
   947→            url = pack_info["url"]
   948→            if url not in packs_needed:
   949→                packs_needed[url] = {
   950→                    "title": pack_info["title"],
   951→                    "url": url,
   952→                    "installed": _is_pack_installed(url),
   953→                    "missing_nodes": [],
   954→                }
   955→            packs_needed[url]["missing_nodes"].append(node_type)
   956→
   957→            missing_report.append({
   958→                "node_type": node_type,
   959→                "pack_title": pack_info["title"],
   960→                "pack_url": url,
   961→                "pack_installed": _is_pack_installed(url),
   962→            })
   963→        else:
   964→            missing_report.append({
   965→                "node_type": node_type,
   966→                "pack_title": None,
   967→                "pack_url": None,
   968→                "message": "Not found in ComfyUI Manager registry.",
   969→            })
   970→
   971→    # Summary
   972→    if not missing:
   973→        return to_json({
   974→            "status": "all_installed",
   975→            "total_node_types": len(class_types),
   976→            "message": "All node types in this workflow are available.",
   977→        })
   978→
   979→    return to_json({
   980→        "status": "missing_nodes",
   981→        "total_node_types": len(class_types),
   982→        "installed_count": len(installed),
   983→        "missing_count": len(missing),
   984→        "missing_nodes": missing_report,
   985→        "packs_to_install": list(packs_needed.values()),
   986→        "install_hint": (
   987→            "Install missing packs via ComfyUI Manager or git clone into "
   988→            f"{CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}"
   989→        ),
   990→    })

   993→def _handle_get_install_instructions(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   994→    """Get install instructions for a node pack or model."""
   995→    query = tool_input["query"]
   996→    source = tool_input.get("source", "registry")
   997→
   998→    if source == "civitai":
   999→        return to_json({
  1000→            "source": "civitai",
  1001→            "query": query,
  1002→            "instructions": (
  1003→                f"To install a CivitAI model, use the CivitAI tools to find the "
  1004→                f"model first (discover), then download the file to the "
  1005→                f"appropriate directory under {MODELS_DIR}. "
  1006→                f"CivitAI models are typically .safetensors files."
  1007→            ),
  1008→            "steps": [

  1015→
  1016→    if source == "huggingface":
  1017→        return to_json({
  1018→            "source": "huggingface",
  1019→            "query": query,
  1020→            "instructions": (
  1021→                f"To install a HuggingFace model, download the .safetensors file "
  1022→                f"to the appropriate directory under {MODELS_DIR}."
  1023→            ),

  1029→            ],
  1030→        })
  1031→
  1032→    # Registry source — look up node packs and models
  1033→    # Try node pack first (by node_type)
  1034→    index = _build_node_to_pack()
  1035→    if query in index:
  1036→        pack = index[query]
  1037→        url = pack["url"]

  1039→        folder = url.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]

  1044→            "type": "node_pack",

  1054→            ] if not installed else [],
  1055→            "message": "Already installed." if installed else f"Clone {url} into Custom_Nodes.",
  1056→        })
  1057→
  1058→    # Try node pack by name search
  1059→    packs = _load_custom_nodes()
  1060→    query_lower = query.lower()
  1061→    for pack in packs:
  1062→        title = pack.get("title", "")
  1063→        ref = pack.get("reference", "")
  1064→        if query_lower in title.lower() or query_lower in ref.lower():
  1065→            installed = _is_pack_installed(ref) if ref else False
  1066→            folder = ref.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1] if ref else ""
  1067→            if folder.endswith(".git"):
  1068→                folder = folder[:-4]
  1069→            return to_json({
  1070→                "source": "registry",
  1071→                "type": "node_pack",
  1072→                "query": query,
  1073→                "pack_title": title,

  1081→                ] if not installed and ref else [],
  1082→                "message": "Already installed." if installed else f"Clone {ref} into Custom_Nodes.",
  1083→            })
  1084→
  1085→    # Try model registry
  1086→    models = _load_model_list()
  1087→    for model in models:
  1088→        name = model.get("name", "")
  1089→        if query_lower in name.lower():
  1090→            filename = model.get("filename", "")
  1091→            save_path = model.get("save_path", "")
  1092→            url = model.get("url", "")
  1093→            installed = _is_model_installed(filename, save_path) if filename and save_path else False
  1094→            return to_json({

  1104→                ] if not installed and url else [],
  1105→                "message": "Already installed." if installed else f"Download {filename} to {save_path}/.",
  1106→            })
  1107→
  1108→    return to_json({

  1115→def _clear_cache():
  1116→    """Clear all in-memory caches, forcing reload from disk on next access."""
  1117→    _cache["custom_nodes"] = None
  1118→    _cache["extension_map"] = None

  1121→    _freshness["custom_nodes_loaded_at"] = None

  1126→def _file_age_info(path: Path) -> dict:
  1127→    """Get age info for a file. Returns dict with exists, modified_at, age_s, age_human."""
  1128→    if not path.exists():
  1129→        return {"exists": False, "path": str(path)}
  1130→
  1131→    mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
  1132→    age_s = time.time() - mtime
  1133→    age_days = age_s / 86400
  1134→
  1135→    if age_days < 1:
  1136→        age_human = f"{age_s / 3600:.1f} hours"
  1137→    else:
  1138→        age_human = f"{age_days:.1f} days"
  1139→
  1140→    if age_s > _WARN_THRESHOLD:
  1141→        status = "very_stale"
  1142→    elif age_s > _STALE_THRESHOLD:
  1143→        status = "stale"
  1144→    else:
  1145→        status = "fresh"
  1146→
  1147→    return {
  1148→        "exists": True,
  1149→        "path": str(path),
  1150→        "age_seconds": round(age_s),
  1151→        "age_human": age_human,
  1152→        "status": status,
  1153→    }

  1156→def _model_dir_stats() -> dict:
  1157→    """Count model files by type in the models directory."""
  1158→    if not MODELS_DIR.exists():
  1159→        return {"exists": False, "path": str(MODELS_DIR)}
  1160→
  1161→    types = {}
  1162→    for subdir in sorted(MODELS_DIR.iterdir()):
  1163→        if subdir.is_dir():
  1164→            count = sum(1 for f in subdir.iterdir() if f.is_file() and f.suffix in (
  1165→                ".safetensors", ".ckpt", ".pt", ".pth", ".bin",
  1166→            ))
  1167→            if count > 0:
  1168→                types[subdir.name] = count
  1169→
  1170→    return {
  1171→        "exists": True,
  1172→        "path": str(MODELS_DIR),
  1173→        "types": types,
  1174→        "total_files": sum(types.values()),
  1175→    }

  1178→def _handle_check_freshness(tool_input: dict) -> str:
  1179→    """Check freshness of registry data and model files."""
  1180→    if tool_input.get("refresh"):
  1181→        _clear_cache()
  1182→
  1183→    # Check registry files
  1184→    registry_files = {
  1185→        "custom_node_list": _MANAGER_DIR / "custom-node-list.json",
  1186→        "extension_node_map": _MANAGER_DIR / "extension-node-map.json",
  1187→        "model_list": _MANAGER_DIR / "model-list.json",
  1188→    }
  1189→
  1190→    registries = {}
  1191→    any_stale = False
  1192→    any_missing = False
  1193→    for key, path in sorted(registry_files.items()):
  1194→        info = _file_age_info(path)
  1195→        registries[key] = info
  1196→        if not info.get("exists"):
  1197→            any_missing = True
  1198→        elif info.get("status") in ("stale", "very_stale"):
  1199→            any_stale = True
  1200→
  1201→    # Cache status
  1202→    cache_status = {
  1203→        "custom_nodes_cached": _cache["custom_nodes"] is not None,
  1204→        "extension_map_cached": _cache["extension_map"] is not None,
  1205→        "node_to_pack_cached": _cache["node_to_pack"] is not None,
  1206→        "model_list_cached": _cache["model_list"] is not None,
  1207→    }
  1208→
  1209→    # Model directory stats
  1210→    models = _model_dir_stats()
  1211→
  1212→    # Build recommendations
  1213→    recommendations = []
  1214→    if any_missing:
  1215→        recommendations.append(
  1216→            "Install ComfyUI Manager to get registry data: "
  1217→            "https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager"
  1218→        )
  1219→    if any_stale:
  1220→        recommendations.append(
  1221→            "Registry files are stale. Open ComfyUI Manager in the browser "
  1222→            "and click 'Update ComfyUI Manager' to refresh."
  1223→        )
  1224→    if tool_input.get("refresh"):
  1225→        recommendations.append("In-memory cache cleared. Next search will reload from disk.")
  1226→
  1227→    return to_json({
  1228→        "registries": registries,
  1229→        "cache": cache_status,
  1230→        "models": models,
  1231→        "manager_installed": _MANAGER_DIR.exists(),
  1232→        "recommendations": recommendations,
  1233→        "refreshed": bool(tool_input.get("refresh")),
  1234→    })
  1235→
  1236→
  1237→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1238→# Dispatch
  1239→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1240→
  1241→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
  1242→    """Execute a comfy_discover tool call."""
  1243→    try:
  1244→        if name == "discover":
  1245→            return _handle_discover(tool_input)
  1246→        elif name == "find_missing_nodes":
  1247→            return _handle_find_missing_nodes(tool_input)
  1248→        elif name == "get_install_instructions":
  1249→            return _handle_get_install_instructions(tool_input)
  1250→        elif name == "check_registry_freshness":
  1251→            return _handle_check_freshness(tool_input)
  1252→        else:
  1253→            return to_json({"error": f"Unknown tool: {name}"})
  1254→    except Exception as e:
  1255→        return to_json({"error": str(e)})

1→"""ComfyUI HTTP API tools.

    12→from ._util import to_json
    13→

    16→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    19→    {
    20→        "name": "is_comfyui_running",

    56→                    ),

    58→                "format": {
    59→                    "type": "string",
    60→                    "enum": ["names_only", "summary", "full"],
    61→                    "description": (
    62→                        "Response format. 'names_only': just class_type names (smallest). "
    63→                        "'summary': name + category + display_name (default). "
    64→                        "'full': includes input types and output types."
    65→                    ),

    71→    {
    72→        "name": "get_node_info",
    73→        "description": (
    74→            "Get detailed info for a specific ComfyUI node type: "
    75→            "its required/optional inputs with types and defaults, "
    76→            "output types, category, and description. "

    78→        ),
    79→        "input_schema": {
    80→            "type": "object",
    81→            "properties": {
    82→                "node_type": {
    83→                    "type": "string",
    84→                    "description": "Exact class_type name of the node.",

    87→            "required": ["node_type"],
    88→        },

    90→    {
    91→        "name": "get_system_stats",
    92→        "description": (
    93→            "Get ComfyUI system stats: GPU info, VRAM usage, "
    94→            "Python version, and currently loaded models."
    95→        ),
    96→        "input_schema": {
    97→            "type": "object",
    98→            "properties": {},
    99→            "required": [],
   100→        },
   101→    },
   102→    {
   103→        "name": "get_queue_status",
   104→        "description": (
   105→            "Get the current ComfyUI queue: running prompts and pending items."
   106→        ),
   107→        "input_schema": {
   108→            "type": "object",
   109→            "properties": {},
   110→            "required": [],
   111→        },
   112→    },
   113→    {
   114→        "name": "get_history",
   115→        "description": (
   116→            "Get execution history from ComfyUI. Optionally filter by prompt_id. "
   117→            "Returns outputs (images, videos) and execution status."
   118→        ),
   119→        "input_schema": {
   120→            "type": "object",
   121→            "properties": {
   122→                "prompt_id": {
   123→                    "type": "string",
   124→                    "description": "Specific prompt ID to look up. Omit for recent history.",
   125→                },
   126→                "max_items": {
   127→                    "type": "integer",
   128→                    "description": "Max number of history items to return (default 5).",
   129→                },
   130→            },
   131→            "required": [],
   132→        },
   133→    },
   134→]
   135→
   136→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   137→# HTTP helpers
   138→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   139→
   140→_TIMEOUT = 15.0
   141→
   142→
   143→def _get(path: str, timeout: float = _TIMEOUT) -> dict:
   144→    """GET request to ComfyUI, returns parsed JSON.
   145→
   146→    Raises httpx.ConnectError or httpx.HTTPStatusError on failure.
   147→    Circuit breaker tracks failures and fast-fails when ComfyUI is down.
   148→    """
   149→    breaker = COMFYUI_BREAKER()
   150→    if not breaker.allow_request():
   151→        raise httpx.ConnectError(
   152→            f"Circuit breaker open — ComfyUI at {COMFYUI_URL} has been unreachable. "
   153→            f"Will retry in {breaker.recovery_timeout:.0f}s."
   154→        )
   155→    try:
   156→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   157→            resp = client.get(f"{COMFYUI_URL}{path}", timeout=timeout)
   158→            resp.raise_for_status()
   159→            breaker.record_success()
   160→            return resp.json()
   161→    except (httpx.ConnectError, httpx.TimeoutException) as e:
   162→        breaker.record_failure()
   163→        raise httpx.ConnectError(str(e)) from e
   164→
   165→

   167→# Handlers
   168→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   169→
   170→def _handle_is_running() -> str:
   171→    try:
   172→        stats = _get("/system_stats", timeout=5.0)
   173→        devices = stats.get("devices", [])
   174→        gpu = devices[0].get("name", "unknown") if devices else "no GPU detected"
   175→        py_ver = stats.get("system", {}).get("python_version", "unknown")
   176→        return to_json({
   177→            "running": True,
   178→            "url": COMFYUI_URL,
   179→            "gpu": gpu,
   180→            "python": py_ver,
   181→        })
   182→    except Exception as e:
   183→        return to_json({
   184→            "running": False,
   185→            "url": COMFYUI_URL,
   186→            "error": str(e),
   187→        })
   188→
   189→
   190→def _handle_get_all_nodes(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   191→    cat_filter = (tool_input.get("category_filter") or "").lower()
   192→    name_filter = (tool_input.get("name_filter") or "").lower()
   193→    fmt = tool_input.get("format", "summary")
   194→
   195→    all_info = _get("/object_info", timeout=30.0)
   196→
   197→    # Apply filters
   198→    filtered_names = []
   199→    for name in sorted(all_info.keys()):
   200→        info = all_info[name]
   201→        cat = (info.get("category") or "").lower()
   202→        if cat_filter and cat_filter not in cat:
   203→            continue
   204→        if name_filter and name_filter not in name.lower():
   205→            continue
   206→        filtered_names.append(name)
   207→
   208→    # Format output based on requested detail level
   209→    if fmt == "names_only":
   210→        return to_json({
   211→            "count": len(filtered_names),
   212→            "nodes": filtered_names,
   213→        })
   214→
   215→    if fmt == "full":
   216→        nodes = {}
   217→        for name in filtered_names:
   218→            info = all_info[name]
   219→            nodes[name] = {
   220→                "category": info.get("category", ""),
   221→                "display_name": info.get("display_name", name),
   222→                "description": info.get("description", ""),
   223→                "input_types": sorted((info.get("input", {}).get("required", {})).keys()),
   224→                "output_types": info.get("output", []),
   225→            }
   226→        return to_json({"count": len(nodes), "nodes": nodes})
   227→
   228→    # Default: summary (name + category + display_name)
   229→    nodes = {}
   230→    for name in filtered_names:
   231→        info = all_info[name]
   232→        nodes[name] = {
   233→            "category": info.get("category", ""),
   234→            "display_name": info.get("display_name", name),
   235→        }
   236→    return to_json({
   237→        "count": len(nodes),
   238→        "nodes": nodes,
   239→        "hint": "Use format='names_only' for smaller response, or get_node_info for details on a specific node.",
   240→    })
   241→
   242→
   243→def _handle_get_node_info(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   244→    node_type = tool_input["node_type"]
   245→    all_info = _get(f"/object_info/{node_type}", timeout=10.0)
   246→
   247→    info = all_info.get(node_type)
   248→    if not info:
   249→        # Try case-insensitive search
   250→        all_nodes = _get("/object_info", timeout=30.0)
   251→        matches = [n for n in all_nodes if n.lower() == node_type.lower()]
   252→        if matches:
   253→            info = all_nodes[matches[0]]
   254→            node_type = matches[0]
   255→        else:
   256→            # Suggest similar names
   257→            # He2025: sort for deterministic suggestion order
   258→            similar = sorted(n for n in all_nodes if node_type.lower() in n.lower())[:10]
   259→            return to_json({
   260→                "error": f"Node type '{node_type}' not found.",
   261→                "similar_nodes": similar,
   262→            })
   263→
   264→    return to_json({
   265→        "class_type": node_type,
   266→        "display_name": info.get("display_name", node_type),
   267→        "category": info.get("category", ""),
   268→        "description": info.get("description", ""),
   269→        "input": info.get("input", {}),
   270→        "output": info.get("output", []),
   271→        "output_name": info.get("output_name", []),
   272→        "output_is_list": info.get("output_is_list", []),
   273→    })
   274→
   275→
   276→def _handle_get_system_stats() -> str:
   277→    stats = _get("/system_stats", timeout=5.0)
   278→    return to_json(stats)
   279→
   280→
   281→def _handle_get_queue() -> str:
   282→    queue = _get("/queue", timeout=5.0)
   283→    running = queue.get("queue_running", [])
   284→    pending = queue.get("queue_pending", [])
   285→    return to_json({
   286→        "running_count": len(running),
   287→        "pending_count": len(pending),
   288→        "running": [{"prompt_id": r[1]} for r in running] if running else [],
   289→        "pending": [{"prompt_id": p[1]} for p in pending] if pending else [],
   290→    })
   291→
   292→
   293→def _handle_get_history(tool_input: dict) -> str:
   294→    prompt_id = tool_input.get("prompt_id")
   295→    max_items = tool_input.get("max_items", 5)
   296→
   297→    if prompt_id:
   298→        history = _get(f"/history/{prompt_id}", timeout=10.0)
   299→    else:
   300→        history = _get("/history", timeout=10.0)
   301→
   302→    # Trim to max_items
   303→    if not prompt_id and len(history) > max_items:
   304→        # History keys are prompt IDs; take most recent
   305→        keys = list(history.keys())[-max_items:]
   306→        history = {k: history[k] for k in keys}
   307→
   308→    # Summarize outputs
   309→    result = {}
   310→    # He2025: sort for deterministic output order
   311→    for pid, entry in sorted(history.items()):
   312→        outputs_summary = []
   313→        for node_id, node_out in sorted(entry.get("outputs", {}).items()):
   314→            for img in node_out.get("images", []):
   315→                outputs_summary.append({
   316→                    "type": "image",
   317→                    "filename": img.get("filename"),
   318→                })
   319→            for vid in node_out.get("gifs", []):
   320→                outputs_summary.append({
   321→                    "type": "video",
   322→                    "filename": vid.get("filename"),
   323→                })
   324→        status_info = entry.get("status", {})
   325→        result[pid] = {
   326→            "status": status_info.get("status_str", "unknown"),
   327→            "completed": status_info.get("completed", False),
   328→            "outputs": outputs_summary,
   329→        }
   330→
   331→    return to_json(result)
   332→
   333→
   334→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   335→# Dispatch
   336→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   337→
   338→def handle(name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
   339→    """Execute a comfy_api tool call."""
   340→    try:
   341→        if name == "is_comfyui_running":
   342→            return _handle_is_running()
   343→        elif name == "get_all_nodes":
   344→            return _handle_get_all_nodes(tool_input)
   345→        elif name == "get_node_info":
   346→            return _handle_get_node_info(tool_input)
   347→        elif name == "get_system_stats":
   348→            return _handle_get_system_stats()
   349→        elif name == "get_queue_status":
   350→            return _handle_get_queue()
   351→        elif name == "get_history":
   352→            return _handle_get_history(tool_input)
   353→        else:
   354→            return to_json({"error": f"Unknown tool: {name}"})
   355→    except httpx.ConnectError:
   356→        return to_json({
   357→            "error": f"Could not connect to ComfyUI at {COMFYUI_URL}. Is it running?",
   358→        })
   359→    except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
   360→        return to_json({
   361→            "error": f"HTTP {e.response.status_code}: {e.response.text[:200]}",
   362→        })
   363→    except Exception as e:
   364→        return to_json({"error": str(e)})
   365→

   111→def _human_size(nbytes: int) -> str:
   112→    """Format bytes as human-readable size."""
   113→    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"):
   114→        if abs(nbytes) < 1024:
   115→            return f"{nbytes:.1f} {unit}"
   116→        nbytes /= 1024
   117→    return f"{nbytes:.1f} PB"

   120→def _is_node_pack(path: Path) -> bool:
   121→    """Check if a directory looks like a custom node pack."""
   122→    if not path.is_dir():
   123→        return False
   124→    name = path.name
   125→    # Skip __pycache__, hidden dirs, temp dirs
   126→    if name.startswith((".", "__", "tmp")):

   128→    # Must have Python files
   129→    return any(path.glob("*.py"))

   161→
   162→        # Try to count registered nodes from __init__.py
   163→        init_file = item / "__init__.py"
   164→        if init_file.exists():

   167→                if "NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS" in content:
   168→                    info["registers_nodes"] = True
   169→            except Exception:
   170→                pass
   171→
   172→        packs.append(info)
   173→
   174→    return to_json({
   175→        "directory": str(CUSTOM_NODES_DIR),
   176→        "count": len(packs),
   177→        "packs": packs,
   178→    })

   143→def _get(path: str, timeout: float = _TIMEOUT) -> dict:
   144→    """GET request to ComfyUI, returns parsed JSON.
   145→
   146→    Raises httpx.ConnectError or httpx.HTTPStatusError on failure.
   147→    Circuit breaker tracks failures and fast-fails when ComfyUI is down.
   148→    """
   149→    breaker = COMFYUI_BREAKER()
   150→    if not breaker.allow_request():
   151→        raise httpx.ConnectError(
   152→            f"Circuit breaker open — ComfyUI at {COMFYUI_URL} has been unreachable. "
   153→            f"Will retry in {breaker.recovery_timeout:.0f}s."
   154→        )
   155→    try:
   156→        with httpx.Client() as client:
   157→            resp = client.get(f"{COMFYUI_URL}{path}", timeout=timeout)
   158→            resp.raise_for_status()
   159→            breaker.record_success()
   160→            return resp.json()
   161→    except (httpx.ConnectError, httpx.TimeoutException) as e:
   162→        breaker.record_failure()
   163→        raise httpx.ConnectError(str(e)) from e

1→# 3D Generation Workflows in ComfyUI
     2→
     3→## Hunyuan3D Pipeline
     4→
     5→Hunyuan3D (Tencent) generates 3D meshes from text or images.
     6→
     7→### Typical Node Chain
     8→1. **LoadImage** or **CLIPTextEncode** -- input conditioning
     9→2. **Hunyuan3DLoader** -- loads the Hunyuan3D model weights
    10→3. **Hunyuan3DConditioner** -- prepares conditioning for 3D generation
    11→4. **Hunyuan3DSampler** -- generates triplane features
    12→5. **Hunyuan3DMeshDecoder** -- decodes triplane to 3D mesh
    13→6. **SaveGLB** or **Preview3D** -- exports the result
    14→
    15→### Key Parameters
    16→- **steps**: 50-100 for quality, 20-30 for speed
    17→- **guidance_scale**: 7.0-10.0 typical
    18→- **resolution**: triplane resolution affects detail (256 = fast, 512 = detailed)
    19→
    20→### VRAM Requirements
    21→- 24GB+ VRAM recommended (RTX 4090 works)
    22→- Reduce triplane resolution to 256 for lower VRAM cards
    23→
    24→## 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)
    25→
    26→Gaussian Splatting creates photorealistic 3D scenes from multi-view images.
    27→
    28→### Common Node Packs
    29→- **ComfyUI-3D-Pack**: comprehensive 3D toolkit
    30→- **ComfyUI-Hunyuan3D**: official Hunyuan3D nodes
    31→
    32→### Output Formats
    33→- `.glb` -- standard 3D interchange, viewable in browsers
    34→- `.ply` -- point cloud format, used by Gaussian Splatting
    35→- `.obj` -- classic mesh format with material support
    36→
    37→## Video-to-3D with Wan2.1
    38→
    39→Wan2.1 (Alibaba) supports video generation that can feed into 3D pipelines.
    40→
    41→### Wan2.1 Variants
    42→- **Wan-T2V**: Text-to-video
    43→- **Wan-I2V**: Image-to-video
    44→- **Wan-Fun**: Creative video effects
    45→
    46→### Integration Pattern
    47→Image -> Wan-I2V (multi-view) -> 3D reconstruction -> Mesh export
    48→
    49→## Model Directory Conventions
    50→- 3D models: `models/3d/` or `models/checkpoints/` (varies by node pack)
    51→- Wan models: `models/diffusion_models/` or `models/checkpoints/`
    52→- Some packs use HuggingFace-style directory downloads (multiple files per model)
    53→
    54→## Tips
    55→- Always check VRAM before loading 3D models -- they're typically larger than 2D
    56→- 3D generation is slower than image generation -- set timeouts to 600s+
    57→- Preview3D nodes may not work in headless mode -- use SaveGLB for exports
    58→- For multi-stage pipelines (image -> 3D), use the pipeline tool to chain stages
    59→

1→# ComfyUI Core Reference
     2→
     3→## Workflow JSON Schema
     4→
     5→A ComfyUI API-format workflow is a JSON object where:
     6→- Top-level keys are string node IDs (usually numeric strings like "3", "12")
     7→- Each node has `class_type` (str) and `inputs` (dict)
     8→- Input values are either literals (int, float, str, bool) or connections
     9→- Connections are 2-element arrays: [source_node_id_str, output_index_int]
    10→
    11→## Type System
    12→
    13→Strict types for node connections:
    14→- MODEL — diffusion model (UNet or DiT)
    15→- CLIP — text encoder
    16→- VAE — variational autoencoder
    17→- CONDITIONING — encoded prompt (NOT raw text)
    18→- LATENT — latent space tensor
    19→- IMAGE — pixel tensor [B,H,W,C] float32 range 0-1
    20→- MASK — single channel [B,H,W]
    21→- STRING, INT, FLOAT, BOOLEAN — primitives
    22→- COMBO — dropdown selection (defined in INPUT_TYPES)
    23→
    24→Types must match on connections. IMAGE cannot connect to LATENT input.
    25→
    26→## Node Registration
    27→
    28→Custom nodes export from __init__.py:
    29→- NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS: dict[str, class] — internal name → class
    30→- NODE_DISPLAY_NAME_MAPPINGS: dict[str, str] — internal name → UI name
    31→
    32→Each node class needs:
    33→- INPUT_TYPES (classmethod) → {"required": {...}, "optional": {...}}
    34→- RETURN_TYPES: tuple of type strings
    35→- RETURN_NAMES: tuple of output names
    36→- FUNCTION: str — method name to call
    37→- CATEGORY: str — menu path in UI
    38→
    39→## API Endpoints
    40→
    41→| Method | Path | Purpose |
    42→|--------|------|---------|
    43→| GET | /object_info | All registered nodes with full interface |
    44→| GET | /object_info/{node} | Single node info |
    45→| POST | /prompt | Queue workflow execution |
    46→| GET | /queue | Running + pending items |
    47→| GET | /history | Past executions with outputs |
    48→| GET | /history/{prompt_id} | Specific execution result |
    49→| GET | /system_stats | GPU, VRAM, loaded models |
    50→| GET | /embeddings | Available text embeddings |
    51→| WS | /ws?clientId={id} | Real-time execution progress |
    52→
    53→## Execution Model
    54→
    55→ComfyUI executes workflows by:
    56→1. Topological sort of the node graph
    57→2. Execute each node in dependency order
    58→3. Cache outputs — unchanged nodes skip execution
    59→4. Report progress via WebSocket
    60→
    61→## Common Model Directories
    62→
    63→models/checkpoints/ — full diffusion models (SD, SDXL, Flux, etc.)
    64→models/loras/ — LoRA adapters
    65→models/vae/ — standalone VAE models
    66→models/controlnet/ — ControlNet models
    67→models/clip/ — standalone CLIP models
    68→models/upscale_models/ — upscaler models
    69→models/embeddings/ — textual inversions
    70→
    71→## Key Patterns
    72→
    73→- Seed is per-sampler-node, not global
    74→- CONDITIONING must go through CLIPTextEncode (never raw string to sampler)
    75→- Image tensors are [B,H,W,C] NOT [B,C,H,W] (ComfyUI convention)
    76→- ControlNet requires resolution matching with the latent
    77→- Empty latent size must be divisible by 8 (usually 64)
    78→- VAE decode and encode are explicit separate nodes
    79→

1→# CLAUDE.md — ComfyUI SUPER DUPER Agent
     2→
     3→> **Core Thesis:** We are not building plumbing. We are building the first AI assistant
     4→> that *understands* a VFX artist's ComfyUI workflow — and keeps up with the ecosystem they can't.
     5→>
     6→> **The Pace Problem:** New models drop daily. Custom nodes ship weekly. No artist can track it all.
     7→> This agent does.
     8→
     9→---
    10→
    11→## IDENTITY
    12→
    13→```
    14→YOU:        The VFX artist's co-pilot. Not a developer tool.
    15→AUDIENCE:   Lighting TDs, compositors, texture artists — NOT engineers.
    16→VOICE:      Knowledgeable colleague, not a terminal. Explain what you're doing and why.
    17→PRINCIPLE:  Driver, not generator. Small validated changes, never full workflow rewrites.
    18→```
    19→
    20→---
    21→
    22→## Project Summary
    23→
    24→ComfyUI SUPER DUPER Agent is an AI co-pilot for ComfyUI workflows. It uses Claude with
    25→60 specialized tools organized into two tiers: four intelligence layers (UNDERSTAND,
    26→DISCOVER, PILOT, VERIFY) and a brain layer (VISION, PLANNER, MEMORY, ORCHESTRATOR,
    27→OPTIMIZER, DEMO). Natural conversation drives workflow inspection, discovery, modification,
    28→execution, optimization, and learning. Built with the Anthropic SDK, httpx, and jsonpatch.
    29→
    30→The primary interface is MCP (Model Context Protocol) via `agent mcp`, making all 65 tools
    31→available to Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or any MCP client. The CLI agent (`agent run`)
    32→serves as a standalone fallback. Our value lives in the intelligence and brain layers above
    33→the transport.
    34→
    35→---
    36→
    37→## Commands
    38→
    39→```bash
    40→# Install
    41→pip install -e ".[dev]"
    42→
    43→# Run (requires .env with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
    44→agent run
    45→agent run --session my-project --verbose
    46→
    47→# Tests (497 tests, all mocked, <35s)
    48→python -m pytest tests/ -v
    49→python -m pytest tests/test_workflow_patch.py -v                              # single file
    50→python -m pytest tests/test_session.py::TestSaveSession -v                    # single class
    51→python -m pytest tests/test_context.py::TestTokenEstimation::test_simple_string -v  # single test
    52→
    53→# Lint
    54→ruff check agent/ tests/
    55→ruff format agent/ tests/
    56→```
    57→
    58→---
    59→
    60→## Claude Code MCP Setup
    61→
    62→This project is MCP-first: Claude Code **is** the agent runtime; these tools are its domain expertise for ComfyUI.
    63→
    64→**Install:**
    65→```bash
    66→pip install -e "."
    67→```
    68→
    69→**Configure** `.claude/settings.json` (or project-level):
    70→```json
    71→{
    72→  "mcpServers": {
    73→    "comfyui-agent": {
    74→      "command": "agent",
    75→      "args": ["mcp"],
    76→      "cwd": "C:/Users/User/comfyui-agent"
    77→    }
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→```
    81→
    82→---
    83→
    84→## Tool Usage Rules
    85→
    86→When using the ComfyUI agent tools via MCP, follow these rules:
    87→
    88→1. **NEVER claim to know about specific models from memory. ALWAYS use tools.** Model ecosystems change daily.
    89→2. When asked "what model should I use for X?" -- search first (`discover`), recommend after.
    90→3. When modifying workflows, ALWAYS show the proposed patch and get confirmation before applying.
    91→4. When something fails, read the error, check node compatibility, suggest fixes.
    92→5. If ComfyUI is not running, say so immediately. Most tools require it.
    93→6. Prefer `get_node_info` over memory for node interfaces. It's always current.
    94→7. When suggesting new nodes/models, check if they're already installed first (`list_models`, `list_custom_nodes`).
    95→8. Log key decisions and preferences to session notes (`add_note`) for continuity.
    96→9. At conversation end, save the session so the user can resume later.
    97→10. Use `format='names_only'` or `format='summary'` for large tool queries; drill down with specific tools.
    98→11. For workflow creation, prefer loading a template (`list_workflow_templates`) and patching it.
    99→12. Before executing, use `validate_before_execute` to catch errors early.
   100→13. Use `add_node`/`connect_nodes`/`set_input` for building workflows instead of raw JSON patches when possible.
   101→14. Never generate entire workflows from scratch. Make surgical, validated modifications.
   102→15. Every patch is validated before application. No exceptions.
   103→
   104→### Tool Overview
   105→
   106→| Category | Tools |
   107→|----------|-------|
   108→| **Live API** | `is_comfyui_running`, `get_all_nodes`, `get_node_info`, `get_system_stats`, `get_queue_status`, `get_history` |
   109→| **Filesystem** | `list_custom_nodes`, `list_models`, `get_models_summary`, `read_node_source` |
   110→| **Workflow Understanding** | `load_workflow`, `validate_workflow`, `get_editable_fields` |
   111→| **Workflow Editing** | `apply_workflow_patch`, `preview_workflow_patch`, `undo_workflow_patch`, `get_workflow_diff`, `save_workflow`, `reset_workflow` |
   112→| **Semantic Building** | `add_node`, `connect_nodes`, `set_input` |
   113→| **Execution** | `validate_before_execute`, `execute_workflow`, `get_execution_status`, `execute_with_progress` |
   114→| **Discovery** | `discover`, `find_missing_nodes`, `check_registry_freshness`, `get_install_instructions` |
   115→| **CivitAI** | `get_civitai_model`, `get_trending_models` |
   116→| **Model Compat** | `identify_model_family`, `check_model_compatibility` |
   117→| **Templates** | `list_workflow_templates`, `get_workflow_template` |
   118→| **Session** | `save_session`, `load_session`, `list_sessions`, `add_note` |
   119→| **Brain: Vision** | `analyze_image`, `compare_outputs`, `suggest_improvements`, `hash_compare_images` |
   120→| **Brain: Planner** | `plan_goal`, `get_plan`, `complete_step`, `replan` |
   121→| **Brain: Memory** | `record_outcome`, `get_learned_patterns`, `get_recommendations`, `detect_implicit_feedback` |
   122→| **Brain: Orchestrator** | `spawn_subtask`, `check_subtasks` |
   123→| **Brain: Optimizer** | `profile_workflow`, `suggest_optimizations`, `check_tensorrt_status`, `apply_optimization` |
   124→| **Brain: Demo** | `start_demo`, `demo_checkpoint` |
   125→
   126→---
   127→
   128→## Artistic Intent to Parameter Translation
   129→
   130→When the artist describes what they want in natural language, translate to ComfyUI parameters:
   131→
   132→| Artist Says | Parameter Direction |
   133→|------------|-------------------|
   134→| "dreamier" / "softer" | Lower CFG (5-7), increase steps, use DPM++ 2M Karras |
   135→| "sharper" / "crisper" | Higher CFG (8-12), use Euler or DPM++ SDE |
   136→| "more photorealistic" | Higher CFG (7-10), use realistic checkpoint, negative: "cartoon, anime, illustration" |
   137→| "more stylized" / "painterly" | Lower CFG (4-6), use artistic checkpoint or LoRA |
   138→| "faster" | Fewer steps (15-20), use LCM/Lightning/Turbo sampler, smaller resolution |
   139→| "higher quality" | More steps (30-50), enable hires fix, use upscaler |
   140→| "consistent lighting" | Add ControlNet depth/normal, reference image via IP-Adapter |
   141→| "similar to this image" | IP-Adapter with reference, or img2img with moderate denoise (0.4-0.6) |
   142→| "more variation" | Higher denoise, different seed, lower CFG |
   143→| "less variation" | Lower denoise, same seed, higher CFG |
   144→
   145→---
   146→
   147→## Model Family Quick Reference
   148→
   149→| Family | Resolution | CFG Range | Negative Prompt | Key Notes |
   150→|--------|-----------|-----------|----------------|-----------|

1→# ComfyUI Core Reference
     2→
     3→## Workflow JSON Schema
     4→
     5→A ComfyUI API-format workflow is a JSON object where:
     6→- Top-level keys are string node IDs (usually numeric strings like "3", "12")
     7→- Each node has `class_type` (str) and `inputs` (dict)
     8→- Input values are either literals (int, float, str, bool) or connections
     9→- Connections are 2-element arrays: [source_node_id_str, output_index_int]
    10→
    11→## Type System
    12→
    13→Strict types for node connections:
    14→- MODEL — diffusion model (UNet or DiT)
    15→- CLIP — text encoder
    16→- VAE — variational autoencoder
    17→- CONDITIONING — encoded prompt (NOT raw text)
    18→- LATENT — latent space tensor
    19→- IMAGE — pixel tensor [B,H,W,C] float32 range 0-1
    20→- MASK — single channel [B,H,W]
    21→- STRING, INT, FLOAT, BOOLEAN — primitives
    22→- COMBO — dropdown selection (defined in INPUT_TYPES)
    23→
    24→Types must match on connections. IMAGE cannot connect to LATENT input.
    25→
    26→## Node Registration
    27→
    28→Custom nodes export from __init__.py:
    29→- NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS: dict[str, class] — internal name → class
    30→- NODE_DISPLAY_NAME_MAPPINGS: dict[str, str] — internal name → UI name
    31→
    32→Each node class needs:
    33→- INPUT_TYPES (classmethod) → {"required": {...}, "optional": {...}}
    34→- RETURN_TYPES: tuple of type strings
    35→- RETURN_NAMES: tuple of output names
    36→- FUNCTION: str — method name to call
    37→- CATEGORY: str — menu path in UI
    38→
    39→## API Endpoints
    40→
    41→| Method | Path | Purpose |
    42→|--------|------|---------|
    43→| GET | /object_info | All registered nodes with full interface |
    44→| GET | /object_info/{node} | Single node info |
    45→| POST | /prompt | Queue workflow execution |
    46→| GET | /queue | Running + pending items |
    47→| GET | /history | Past executions with outputs |
    48→| GET | /history/{prompt_id} | Specific execution result |
    49→| GET | /system_stats | GPU, VRAM, loaded models |
    50→| GET | /embeddings | Available text embeddings |
    51→| WS | /ws?clientId={id} | Real-time execution progress |
    52→
    53→## Execution Model
    54→
    55→ComfyUI executes workflows by:
    56→1. Topological sort of the node graph
    57→2. Execute each node in dependency order
    58→3. Cache outputs — unchanged nodes skip execution
    59→4. Report progress via WebSocket
    60→
    61→## Common Model Directories
    62→
    63→models/checkpoints/ — full diffusion models (SD, SDXL, Flux, etc.)
    64→models/loras/ — LoRA adapters
    65→models/vae/ — standalone VAE models
    66→models/controlnet/ — ControlNet models
    67→models/clip/ — standalone CLIP models
    68→models/upscale_models/ — upscaler models
    69→models/embeddings/ — textual inversions
    70→
    71→## Key Patterns
    72→
    73→- Seed is per-sampler-node, not global
    74→- CONDITIONING must go through CLIPTextEncode (never raw string to sampler)
    75→- Image tensors are [B,H,W,C] NOT [B,C,H,W] (ComfyUI convention)
    76→- ControlNet requires resolution matching with the latent
    77→- Empty latent size must be divisible by 8 (usually 64)
    78→- VAE decode and encode are explicit separate nodes
    79→

1→"""Build the agent's system prompt from knowledge files and context."""
     2→
     3→from .config import KNOWLEDGE_DIR, COMFYUI_DATABASE, CUSTOM_NODES_DIR, MODELS_DIR
     4→
     5→_RULES = """\
     6→RULES:
     7→1. NEVER claim to know about specific models from memory. ALWAYS use tools.
     8→2. When asked "what model should I use for X?" — search first, recommend after.
     9→3. When modifying workflows, ALWAYS show the proposed patch and get confirmation before applying.
    10→4. When something fails, read the error, check node compatibility, suggest fixes.
    11→5. Use extended thinking for: workflow design from scratch, debugging, architecture decisions.
    12→6. Use standard responses for: simple queries, status checks, model listings.
    13→7. If ComfyUI is not running, say so immediately. Most tools require it.
    14→8. Prefer /object_info over memory for node interfaces. It's always current.
    15→9. When suggesting new nodes/models, check if they're already installed first.
    16→10. Log key decisions and preferences to session notes (add_note) for continuity.
    17→11. At conversation end, save the session so the user can resume later.
    18→12. Use format='names_only' or format='summary' for large tool queries; drill down with specific tools.
    19→13. For workflow creation, prefer loading a template (list_workflow_templates) and patching it.
    20→14. Before executing, use validate_before_execute to catch errors early.
    21→15. Use add_node/connect_nodes/set_input for building workflows instead of raw JSON patches when possible.
    22→16. When past outcomes exist, proactively mention relevant patterns without overwhelming.
    23→
    24→TOOL OVERVIEW:
    25→
    26→Inspection (live API):
    27→  is_comfyui_running, get_all_nodes, get_node_info, get_system_stats,
    28→  get_queue_status, get_history
    29→
    30→Filesystem:
    31→  list_custom_nodes, list_models, get_models_summary, read_node_source
    32→
    33→Workflow Understanding:
    34→  load_workflow, validate_workflow, get_editable_fields
    35→
    36→Workflow Editing (RFC6902 JSON Patch):
    37→  apply_workflow_patch, preview_workflow_patch, undo_workflow_patch,
    38→  get_workflow_diff, save_workflow, reset_workflow
    39→
    40→Semantic Workflow Building:
    41→  add_node, connect_nodes, set_input
    42→
    43→Execution:
    44→  validate_before_execute, execute_workflow, get_execution_status
    45→
    46→Discovery:
    47→  discover (unified search across registry, CivitAI, HuggingFace for nodes and models),
    48→  find_missing_nodes (dependency analysis with install suggestions),
    49→  check_node_updates (GitHub release tracking for installed packs),
    50→  get_repo_releases (release history for a specific GitHub repo)
    51→
    52→Templates:
    53→  list_workflow_templates, get_workflow_template
    54→
    55→Session Memory:
    56→  save_session, load_session, list_sessions, add_note
    57→"""
    58→
    59→# Keyword -> knowledge file mapping for dynamic loading
    60→_KNOWLEDGE_TRIGGERS = {
    61→    "controlnet_patterns": [
    62→        "controlnet", "control_net", "depth_map", "canny", "openpose",
    63→        "lineart", "scribble", "ControlNetLoader", "ControlNetApply",
    64→    ],
    65→    "video_workflows": [
    66→        "animatediff", "animate", "video", "svd", "stable_video",
    67→        "frame", "motion", "AnimateDiffLoader", "VHS_",
    68→    ],
    69→    "flux_specifics": [
    70→        "flux", "FLUX", "FluxGuidance", "FluxLoader",
    71→    ],
    72→    "common_recipes": [
    73→        "create workflow", "build workflow", "from scratch",
    74→        "new workflow", "make a workflow", "set up a pipeline",
    75→    ],
    76→    "3d_workflows": [
    77→        "3d", "3D", "mesh", "hunyuan3d", "Hunyuan3D", "triplane",
    78→        "gaussian", "splat", "3dgs", "3DGS", "glb", "GLB", "ply",
    79→        "point_cloud", "Hunyuan3DLoader", "SaveGLB", "Preview3D",
    80→        "Load3DGaussian", "MeshDecoder", "3d_gen",
    81→        "3d generation", "Wan2.1", "wan2", "Wan-T2V", "Wan-I2V",
    82→    ],
    83→    "audio_workflows": [
    84→        "tts", "TTS", "text to speech", "audio", "voice",
    85→        "cosyvoice", "CosyVoice", "CosyVoiceLoader",
    86→        "qwen audio", "QwenAudio", "bark", "tortoise",
    87→        "xtts", "XTTS", "fish speech", "chattts", "ChatTTS",
    88→        "SaveAudio", "LoadAudio", "AudioSave",
    89→        "text-to-speech", "narration", "speech synthesis",
    90→    ],
    91→}
    92→
    93→
    94→def _detect_relevant_knowledge(session_context: dict | None) -> set[str]:
    95→    """Detect which optional knowledge files to load based on context."""
    96→    triggers = set()
    97→
    98→    if not session_context:
    99→        return triggers
   100→
   101→    # Check workflow node types
   102→    wf = session_context.get("workflow", {})
   103→    workflow_text = ""
   104→    if wf.get("current_workflow") and isinstance(wf["current_workflow"], dict):
   105→        # He2025: sort to ensure deterministic keyword detection
   106→        class_types = sorted([
   107→            n.get("class_type", "")
   108→            for n in wf["current_workflow"].values()
   109→            if isinstance(n, dict)
   110→        ])
   111→        workflow_text = " ".join(class_types)
   112→
   113→    # Check notes
   114→    notes_text = " ".join(
   115→        n.get("text", "") if isinstance(n, dict) else str(n)
   116→        for n in session_context.get("notes", [])
   117→    )
   118→
   119→    combined = f"{workflow_text} {notes_text}".lower()
   120→
   121→    for knowledge_file, keywords in _KNOWLEDGE_TRIGGERS.items():
   122→        if any(kw.lower() in combined for kw in keywords):
   123→            triggers.add(knowledge_file)
   124→
   125→    return triggers
   126→
   127→
   128→def build_system_prompt(session_context: dict | None = None) -> str:
   129→    """Assemble the full system prompt from knowledge files, session context, and rules.
   130→
   131→    Args:
   132→        session_context: Optional session data dict with 'notes', 'workflow', 'name' keys.
   133→                        When provided, injects session memory and loads relevant knowledge.
   134→    """
   135→    parts = [
   136→        "You are a ComfyUI co-pilot — an expert assistant that helps artists "
   137→        "inspect, understand, discover, modify, and execute ComfyUI workflows "
   138→        "through natural conversation.\n",
   139→        "You have tools to query the live ComfyUI API, scan the local filesystem, "
   140→        "search for custom node packs and models in the ComfyUI Manager registry, "
   141→        "and search HuggingFace Hub for broader model discovery.\n",
   142→        f"ComfyUI installation: {COMFYUI_DATABASE}\n"
   143→        f"Custom nodes: {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}\n"
   144→        f"Models: {MODELS_DIR}\n",
   145→    ]
   146→
   147→    # Inject session context (privileged position — before knowledge)
   148→    if session_context:
   149→        parts.append("\n--- Session Context ---")
   150→        session_name = session_context.get("name", "")
   151→        if session_name:
   152→            parts.append(f"Active session: {session_name}")
   153→
   154→        # Loaded workflow summary
   155→        wf = session_context.get("workflow", {})
   156→        if wf.get("loaded_path"):
   157→            parts.append(f"Loaded workflow: {wf['loaded_path']} (format: {wf.get('format', '?')})")
   158→            if wf.get("history_depth", 0) > 0:
   159→                parts.append(f"  Patches applied: {wf['history_depth']}")
   160→
   161→        # Session notes (most recent 10)
   162→        notes = session_context.get("notes", [])
   163→        if notes:
   164→            parts.append("User preferences and notes from previous sessions:")
   165→            for note in notes[-10:]:
   166→                text = note.get("text", "") if isinstance(note, dict) else str(note)
   167→                parts.append(f"  - {text}")
   168→        parts.append("")
   169→
   170→    # Proactive recommendations from memory (if outcomes exist)
   171→    if session_context and session_context.get("name"):
   172→        try:
   173→            from .brain.memory import handle as memory_handle
   174→            import json as _json
   175→            recs_raw = memory_handle("get_recommendations", {
   176→                "session": session_context["name"],
   177→            })
   178→            recs = _json.loads(recs_raw)
   179→            top_recs = [
   180→                r for r in recs.get("recommendations", [])
   181→                if r.get("confidence", 0) >= 0.7
   182→            ][:3]
   183→            if top_recs:
   184→                parts.append("\n--- Recommendations from Past Sessions ---")
   185→                for rec in top_recs:
   186→                    parts.append(
   187→                        f"  - [{rec.get('category', '?')}] "
   188→                        f"{rec.get('recommendation', '')}"
   189→                    )
   190→                parts.append("")
   191→        except Exception:
   192→            pass  # Memory unavailable — skip silently
   193→
   194→    # Load core knowledge files (always)
   195→    relevant_extras = _detect_relevant_knowledge(session_context)
   196→    if KNOWLEDGE_DIR.exists():
   197→        for md_file in sorted(KNOWLEDGE_DIR.glob("*.md")):
   198→            stem = md_file.stem
   199→            # Always load core knowledge; load extras only if relevant
   200→            is_core = stem == "comfyui_core"
   201→            is_relevant_extra = stem in relevant_extras
   202→            if is_core or is_relevant_extra:
   203→                try:
   204→                    content = md_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
   205→                    parts.append(f"\n--- {stem} ---\n{content}\n")
   206→                except Exception:
   207→                    pass
   208→
   209→    parts.append(f"\n{_RULES}")
   210→
   211→    return "\n".join(parts)
   212→

1→"""Workflow patching tools.
     2→
     3→Apply RFC6902 JSON patches to ComfyUI workflows with full undo support.
     4→The agent reasons about what changes to make, then calls these tools
     5→with concrete patch operations.
     6→
     7→State is module-level: load a workflow once, patch it multiple times,
     8→undo as needed, then save or execute.
     9→"""
    10→
    11→import copy
    12→import json
    13→from pathlib import Path
    14→
    15→import jsonpatch
    16→
    17→from ._util import to_json
    18→
    19→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    20→# Module-level state (one active workflow at a time)
    21→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    22→# WorkflowSession is dict-like: _state["key"] and _state.get("key") work.
    23→# The lock is per-session, so the existing `with _state_lock:` pattern
    24→# continues to work for the default session.
    25→
    26→from ..workflow_session import get_session
    27→
    28→_state = get_session("default")
    29→_state_lock = _state._lock
    30→
    31→
    32→def _ensure_loaded() -> str | None:
    33→    """Return error message if no workflow is loaded, else None."""
    34→    if _state["current_workflow"] is None:
    35→        return "No workflow loaded. Use apply_workflow_patch with a file path first."
    36→    return None
    37→
    38→
    39→def _load_workflow(path_str: str) -> str | None:
    40→    """Load a workflow into state. Returns error or None."""
    41→    from ._util import validate_path
    42→    path_err = validate_path(path_str, must_exist=True)
    43→    if path_err:
    44→        return path_err
    45→    path = Path(path_str)
    46→
    47→    try:
    48→        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    49→    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
    50→        return f"Invalid JSON: {e}"
    51→
    52→    # Extract API format
    53→    if "nodes" in data and isinstance(data["nodes"], list):
    54→        prompt_data = data.get("extra", {}).get("prompt")
    55→        if prompt_data and isinstance(prompt_data, dict):
    56→            api_nodes = {
    57→                k: v for k, v in prompt_data.items()
    58→                if isinstance(v, dict) and "class_type" in v
    59→            }
    60→            _state["format"] = "ui_with_api"
    61→        else:
    62→            return (
    63→                "UI-only workflow format -- can't patch without API data. "
    64→                "Re-export using 'Save (API Format)' in ComfyUI."
    65→            )
    66→    else:
    67→        api_nodes = {
    68→            k: v for k, v in data.items()
    69→            if isinstance(v, dict) and "class_type" in v
    70→        }
    71→        _state["format"] = "api"
    72→
    73→    if not api_nodes:
    74→        return "No nodes found in workflow."
    75→
    76→    _state["loaded_path"] = path_str
    77→    _state["base_workflow"] = copy.deepcopy(api_nodes)
    78→    _state["current_workflow"] = copy.deepcopy(api_nodes)
    79→    _state["history"] = []
    80→    return None
    81→
    82→
    83→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    84→# Tool schemas
    85→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    86→
    87→TOOLS: list[dict] = [
    88→    {
    89→        "name": "apply_workflow_patch",
    90→        "description": (
    91→            "Apply RFC6902 JSON patches to a workflow. If no workflow is "
    92→            "loaded yet, provide the file path to load it first. "
    93→            "Patches use the format: "
    94→            '[{"op": "replace", "path": "/node_id/inputs/field", "value": new_value}]. '
    95→            "Returns the changes made and the current state of affected fields. "
    96→            "Supports undo via undo_workflow_patch."
    97→        ),
    98→        "input_schema": {
    99→            "type": "object",
   100→            "properties": {
   101→                "path": {
   102→                    "type": "string",
   103→                    "description": (
   104→                        "Path to workflow JSON file. Required on first call, "
   105→                        "optional after (reuses loaded workflow)."
   106→                    ),
   107→                },
   108→                "patches": {
   109→                    "type": "array",
   110→                    "description": (
   111→                        "RFC6902 patch operations. Each has 'op' (usually 'replace'), "
   112→                        "'path' (e.g. '/5/inputs/text'), and 'value'."
   113→                    ),
   114→                    "items": {
   115→                        "type": "object",
   116→                        "properties": {
   117→                            "op": {"type": "string"},
   118→                            "path": {"type": "string"},
   119→                            "value": {},
   120→                        },
   121→                        "required": ["op", "path", "value"],
   122→                    },
   123→                },
   124→            },
   125→            "required": ["patches"],
   126→        },
   127→    },
   128→    {

   132→            "Shows before/after values for each affected field."
   133→        ),
   134→        "input_schema": {
   135→            "type": "object",
   136→            "properties": {
   137→                "patches": {
   138→                    "type": "array",
   139→                    "description": "RFC6902 patch operations to preview.",
   140→                    "items": {
   141→                        "type": "object",

   144→                            "path": {"type": "string"},

   170→            "Useful for reviewing everything that's been modified."
   171→        ),
   172→        "input_schema": {

1→"""Build the agent's system prompt from knowledge files and context."""
     2→
     3→from .config import KNOWLEDGE_DIR, COMFYUI_DATABASE, CUSTOM_NODES_DIR, MODELS_DIR
     4→
     5→_RULES = """\
     6→RULES:
     7→1. NEVER claim to know about specific models from memory. ALWAYS use tools.
     8→2. When asked "what model should I use for X?" — search first, recommend after.
     9→3. When modifying workflows, ALWAYS show the proposed patch and get confirmation before applying.
    10→4. When something fails, read the error, check node compatibility, suggest fixes.
    11→5. Use extended thinking for: workflow design from scratch, debugging, architecture decisions.
    12→6. Use standard responses for: simple queries, status checks, model listings.
    13→7. If ComfyUI is not running, say so immediately. Most tools require it.
    14→8. Prefer /object_info over memory for node interfaces. It's always current.
    15→9. When suggesting new nodes/models, check if they're already installed first.
    16→10. Log key decisions and preferences to session notes (add_note) for continuity.
    17→11. At conversation end, save the session so the user can resume later.
    18→12. Use format='names_only' or format='summary' for large tool queries; drill down with specific tools.
    19→13. For workflow creation, prefer loading a template (list_workflow_templates) and patching it.
    20→14. Before executing, use validate_before_execute to catch errors early.
    21→15. Use add_node/connect_nodes/set_input for building workflows instead of raw JSON patches when possible.
    22→16. When past outcomes exist, proactively mention relevant patterns without overwhelming.
    23→
    24→TOOL OVERVIEW:
    25→
    26→Inspection (live API):
    27→  is_comfyui_running, get_all_nodes, get_node_info, get_system_stats,
    28→  get_queue_status, get_history
    29→
    30→Filesystem:
    31→  list_custom_nodes, list_models, get_models_summary, read_node_source
    32→
    33→Workflow Understanding:
    34→  load_workflow, validate_workflow, get_editable_fields
    35→
    36→Workflow Editing (RFC6902 JSON Patch):
    37→  apply_workflow_patch, preview_workflow_patch, undo_workflow_patch,
    38→  get_workflow_diff, save_workflow, reset_workflow
    39→
    40→Semantic Workflow Building:
    41→  add_node, connect_nodes, set_input
    42→
    43→Execution:
    44→  validate_before_execute, execute_workflow, get_execution_status
    45→
    46→Discovery:
    47→  discover (unified search across registry, CivitAI, HuggingFace for nodes and models),
    48→  find_missing_nodes (dependency analysis with install suggestions),
    49→  check_node_updates (GitHub release tracking for installed packs),
    50→  get_repo_releases (release history for a specific GitHub repo)
    51→
    52→Templates:
    53→  list_workflow_templates, get_workflow_template
    54→
    55→Session Memory:
    56→  save_session, load_session, list_sessions, add_note
    57→"""
    58→
    59→# Keyword -> knowledge file mapping for dynamic loading
    60→_KNOWLEDGE_TRIGGERS = {
    61→    "controlnet_patterns": [
    62→        "controlnet", "control_net", "depth_map", "canny", "openpose",
    63→        "lineart", "scribble", "ControlNetLoader", "ControlNetApply",

    74→        "new workflow", "make a workflow", "set up a pipeline",
    75→    ],
    76→    "3d_workflows": [
    77→        "3d", "3D", "mesh", "hunyuan3d", "Hunyuan3D", "triplane",
    78→        "gaussian", "splat", "3dgs", "3DGS", "glb", "GLB", "ply",
    79→        "point_cloud", "Hunyuan3DLoader", "SaveGLB", "Preview3D",
    80→        "Load3DGaussian", "MeshDecoder", "3d_gen",
    81→        "3d generation", "Wan2.1", "wan2", "Wan-T2V", "Wan-I2V",
    82→    ],
    83→    "audio_workflows": [
    84→        "tts", "TTS", "text to speech", "audio", "voice",
    85→        "cosyvoice", "CosyVoice", "CosyVoiceLoader",
    86→        "qwen audio", "QwenAudio", "bark", "tortoise",
    87→        "xtts", "XTTS", "fish speech", "chattts", "ChatTTS",
    88→        "SaveAudio", "LoadAudio", "AudioSave",
    89→        "text-to-speech", "narration", "speech synthesis",
    90→    ],
    91→}
    92→
    93→
    94→def _detect_relevant_knowledge(session_context: dict | None) -> set[str]:
    95→    """Detect which optional knowledge files to load based on context."""
    96→    triggers = set()
    97→
    98→    if not session_context:
    99→        return triggers
   100→
   101→    # Check workflow node types
   102→    wf = session_context.get("workflow", {})
   103→    workflow_text = ""
   104→    if wf.get("current_workflow") and isinstance(wf["current_workflow"], dict):
   105→        # He2025: sort to ensure deterministic keyword detection
   106→        class_types = sorted([
   107→            n.get("class_type", "")
   108→            for n in wf["current_workflow"].values()
   109→            if isinstance(n, dict)
   110→        ])
   111→        workflow_text = " ".join(class_types)
   112→
   113→    # Check notes
   114→    notes_text = " ".join(
   115→        n.get("text", "") if isinstance(n, dict) else str(n)
   116→        for n in session_context.get("notes", [])
   117→    )
   118→
   119→    combined = f"{workflow_text} {notes_text}".lower()
   120→
   121→    for knowledge_file, keywords in _KNOWLEDGE_TRIGGERS.items():
   122→        if any(kw.lower() in combined for kw in keywords):
   123→            triggers.add(knowledge_file)
   124→
   125→    return triggers
   126→
   127→
   128→def build_system_prompt(session_context: dict | None = None) -> str:
   129→    """Assemble the full system prompt from knowledge files, session context, and rules.
   130→
   131→    Args:
   132→        session_context: Optional session data dict with 'notes', 'workflow', 'name' keys.
   133→                        When provided, injects session memory and loads relevant knowledge.
   134→    """
   135→    parts = [
   136→        "You are a ComfyUI co-pilot — an expert assistant that helps artists "
   137→        "inspect, understand, discover, modify, and execute ComfyUI workflows "
   138→        "through natural conversation.\n",
   139→        "You have tools to query the live ComfyUI API, scan the local filesystem, "
   140→        "search for custom node packs and models in the ComfyUI Manager registry, "
   141→        "and search HuggingFace Hub for broader model discovery.\n",
   142→        f"ComfyUI installation: {COMFYUI_DATABASE}\n"
   143→        f"Custom nodes: {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}\n"
   144→        f"Models: {MODELS_DIR}\n",
   145→    ]
   146→
   147→    # Inject session context (privileged position — before knowledge)
   148→    if session_context:
   149→        parts.append("\n--- Session Context ---")
   150→        session_name = session_context.get("name", "")

   148→def _trace_connections(nodes: dict) -> list[dict]:
   149→    """
   150→    Trace connections between nodes.
   151→
   152→    In API format, a connection is an input value that's a list:
   153→    [source_node_id_str, output_index_int]
   154→
   155→    Returns list of connection dicts.
   156→    """
   157→    connections = []
   158→    for target_id, node in sorted(nodes.items()):
   159→        if node.get("_ui_node"):
   160→            continue  # UI-only nodes don't have connection info
   161→        for input_name, value in sorted(node.get("inputs", {}).items()):
   162→            if isinstance(value, list) and len(value) == 2:
   163→                source_id = str(value[0])
   164→                output_idx = value[1]
   165→                source_class = nodes.get(source_id, {}).get("class_type", "?")
   166→                target_class = node.get("class_type", "?")
   167→                connections.append({
   168→                    "from_node": source_id,
   169→                    "from_class": source_class,
   170→                    "from_output": output_idx,
   171→                    "to_node": target_id,
   172→                    "to_class": target_class,
   173→                    "to_input": input_name,
   174→                })
   175→    return connections
   176→
   177→
   178→def _find_editable_fields(nodes: dict, class_filter: str = "") -> list[dict]:
   179→    """
   180→    Find all non-connection input fields (the editable parameters).
   181→    """
   182→    fields = []
   183→    filter_lower = class_filter.lower()
   184→
   185→    for nid, node in sorted(nodes.items()):
   186→        if node.get("_ui_node"):
   187→            continue
   188→        class_type = node.get("class_type", "")
   189→        if filter_lower and filter_lower not in class_type.lower():
   190→            continue
   191→
   192→        # He2025: sort for deterministic field order per node
   193→        for field_name, value in sorted(node.get("inputs", {}).items()):
   194→            # Skip connections (2-element list [node_id, output_index])
   195→            if isinstance(value, list) and len(value) == 2:
   196→                continue
   197→
   198→            fields.append({
   199→                "node_id": nid,
   200→                "class_type": class_type,
   201→                "field": field_name,
   202→                "value": value,
   203→                "type": type(value).__name__,
   204→            })
   205→
   206→    return fields
   207→
   208→
   209→def _build_summary(nodes: dict, connections: list[dict], fmt: str) -> str:
   210→    """Build a human-readable summary of the workflow pipeline."""
   211→    if not nodes:
   212→        return "Empty workflow (no nodes found)."
   213→
   214→    lines = []
   215→
   216→    # Class type counts
   217→    class_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
   218→    for node in nodes.values():
   219→        ct = node.get("class_type", "Unknown")
   220→        class_counts[ct] = class_counts.get(ct, 0) + 1
   221→
   222→    lines.append(f"{len(nodes)} nodes, {len(connections)} connections")
   223→    lines.append("")
   224→
   225→    # Identify pipeline stages by looking at node classes
   226→    loaders = []
   227→    encoders = []
   228→    samplers = []
   229→    outputs = []
   230→    other = []
   231→
   232→    for ct in sorted(class_counts.keys()):
   233→        ct_lower = ct.lower()
   234→        if any(k in ct_lower for k in ("load", "checkpoint", "unet", "model")):
   235→            loaders.append(ct)
   236→        elif any(k in ct_lower for k in ("encode", "clip", "conditioning")):
   237→            encoders.append(ct)
   238→        elif any(k in ct_lower for k in ("sample", "sampler", "ksampler", "denoise")):
   239→            samplers.append(ct)
   240→        elif any(k in ct_lower for k in ("save", "preview", "output", "combine", "video")):
   241→            outputs.append(ct)
   242→        else:
   243→            other.append(ct)
   244→
   245→    if loaders:
   246→        lines.append(f"Loaders: {', '.join(loaders)}")
   247→    if encoders:
   248→        lines.append(f"Encoding: {', '.join(encoders)}")
   249→    if samplers:
   250→        lines.append(f"Sampling: {', '.join(samplers)}")
   251→    if outputs:
   252→        lines.append(f"Output: {', '.join(outputs)}")
   253→    if other:
   254→        lines.append(f"Other: {', '.join(other)}")
   255→
   256→    # Describe data flow from connections
   257→    if connections:
   258→        lines.append("")
   259→        lines.append("Data flow:")
   260→        # Group by target node to show input sources
   261→        by_target: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   262→        for conn in connections:
   263→            key = f"{conn['to_node']} ({conn['to_class']})"
   264→            by_target.setdefault(key, []).append(conn)
   265→
   266→        for target, conns in sorted(by_target.items()):
   267→            sources = [f"{c['from_class']}.out[{c['from_output']}]" for c in conns]
   268→            lines.append(f"  {target} <- {', '.join(sources)}")
   269→
   270→    if fmt == "ui_only":
   271→        lines.append("")
   272→        lines.append(
   273→            "Note: UI-only format — editable field values not available. "
   274→            "Use an API-format workflow for full analysis."
   275→        )
   276→
   277→    return "\n".join(lines)
